|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Lord Maul With Lightsaber (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-D-lordmaulwithlightsaber-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-lordmaulwithlightsab022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Maul’s Lightsaber”. Text: “During battle with a Jedi (unless Obi-Wan here), your battle and weapon destiny draws are +1. Permanent weapon is •Maul's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lord Maul With Lightsaber (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-lordmaulwithlightsaba5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “During battle with a Jedi (unless Obi-Wan here), your battle and weapon destiny draws are +1. Permanent weapon” → “Permanent weapon”; “Lightsaber (may target a” → “Lightsaber (may add 1 to Force drain where present; adds 1 to your battle destiny draws here; may target a”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Maul’s Lightsaber”. Text: “Permanent weapon is •Maul's Lightsaber (may add 1 to Force drain where present; adds 1 to your battle destiny draws here; may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lord Maul With Lightsaber (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-lordmaulwithlightsab6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Maul’s Lightsaber”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Permanent weapon is •Maul's Lightsaber (may add 1 to Force drain where present; adds 1 to your battle destiny draws here; may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”
